parameters.capacity_status: Approximate value stated in paper section 3.1, not a precisely measured capacity or uncertainty bound; never equated to pure-CaO capacity.
parameters.rate_window_interpretation: Necessary interval rate of a conditional constant-capacity F1 law. No fitted kinetic parameters, derivative smoothing, Arrhenius inference, or physical acceptance threshold.

observation_class: author-published processed normalized measurements, not raw balance signal

long_exposure_conflict.resolution: Unresolved primary paper caption versus author workbook; excluded from any thermal rate inference.
